{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers AND exclude missing age (-1)
converted_df = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding missing age): {mean_age}')"}
